The first hash uses the existing no-follow stable streaming hash_file; cached reads compare st_dev/st_ino/st_size/st_mtime_ns/st_ctime_ns through existing evidence.resolver._regular, including its Windows descriptor metadata-change clock.

Every Checker/progress boundary and outer read-only phase audits the full registered snapshot union in finally, including child-only paths, errors and semantic result hits. Outer exit clears hashes and semantic eligibility metadata.
Historical checker objects retain copied context/completion records and register/revalidate their entire snapshot closure on every later run, even when a gate body consumes no snapshot.

Semantic result hits require the same strongly referenced cache object, exact result key, current result object identity and unchanged canonical-JSON SHA256, all registered in the active owner. New owner means fresh dependency validation. Existing semantic cache reset/cycle/stack conditions are unchanged.

Read-only continuation preflight shares one owner for all prior-attempt checks and closes before capture_context writes snapshot hard links. Capture/assessment/staging/activation/CLI dispatch do not span writes with a hash owner.
Already registered historical canonical/execution-inventory snapshot hashes reuse the same owner. Ordinary inventory reads and fresh execution-tree listings retain their prior behavior.
